The angular first reciprocal moment is 1/√(ab) by the tangent substitution, and differentiating it jointly in a and b gives the second moment (a+b)/(2(ab)^(3/2)). The radial moments 2 and 8 and the Gaussian coordinate variances give the two claimed variances, whose difference factors as stated. Independent averaging yields error difference bias²−(2 Var(S₂)−Var(S₁))/M at equal product count, giving the exact even-budget inequalities and the example M*=44. This compares the two homogeneous allocations under the stated per-node cost, not mixtures, total running time, or corrected covariance.
